study: NuCLS v26.1 correct-specification calibration and design-support study

original_proposal.bayesian_cross_fitting: M1 and M2 proposed for every generated dataset

amended_primary_design.replication_rule: use frozen replications 000-099 in every scenario
amended_primary_design.iMRMC: evaluate where generated design satisfies comparator requirements
amended_primary_design.cross_fitting: M1-to-M2 and M2-to-M1 are secondary/supplemental structural comparisons, not required for the primary correct-specification calibration analysis. The existing A1-A8 battery remains the principal misspecification study.

rationale: match the 100-replication-per-scenario convention used in the completed A1-A8 adversarial battery
reduce computational burden while reporting Monte Carlo uncertainty
focus the new primary study on the methodological gap it was designed to fill: correct-specification calibration and design support
timing_and_selection: This amendment was fixed after dataset generation and engineering smoke testing but before definitive Bayesian calibration results were produced. Replications 100-199 remain archived and cannot replace failed replications 000-099.

scientific_gates.coverage: 0.92 to 0.98, interpreted with Monte Carlo SE
scientific_gates.directional_bias: no systematic directional bias with increasing reader/slide support
